# Security, Auditability & Testability Requirements Checklist: ServiceDesk Lite

**Purpose**: Evaluate the quality of the written requirements (spec, plan, contract) for clarity, completeness, security, auditability, negative paths and testability. This checks the documents only; no code exists or has been verified.
**Created**: 2026-11-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [contracts/openapi.yaml](../contracts/openapi.yaml)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Depth/Audience**: Standard depth, reviewer audience, run before `/speckit-tasks` (Gate D readiness). All items start unchecked. Items marked "Observation" record a gap or conflict noticed while writing the checklist; they are leads for the reviewer, not conclusions.

## Authorization & Ownership Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Is the 404-versus-403 rule stated in the spec, not only in plan/contract, for each protected resource? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Plan §Authorization Design] Observation: spec says refusals must not reveal existence; 404 is chosen only in the plan.
- [ ] CHK002 For transition requests, is it defined which failures return "not visible" and which return "forbidden" (for example an assigned agent attempting `CLOSED`)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013, FR-030, Contract `/transitions`]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "addressed to them" for manager visibility defined well enough to write an access test? [Clarity, Spec §FR-031, OQ-06, Plan D-04] Observation: the interim rule "any non-owner manager" would let every manager see every ACCESS request, which may conflict with DR-06.
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for what a manager can see after deciding a request (still visible or not)? [Gap, Spec §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK005 Are assignment constraints specified: allowed request statuses, eligible assignee (active AGENT only), reassignment, and unassignment? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the effects of role changes on in-flight requests, active sessions and approvals defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK007 Are lock-out protections (last administrator, self-demotion) specified or explicitly excluded? [Gap, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements defined for deactivated users (cannot sign in, owned requests stay visible to authorized roles)? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK009 Is multi-role handling an explicit exclusion in requirement text, not only an open question? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions, OQ-04]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "default deny" expressed as a testable requirement (what proves a route cannot be reached without an explicit allow)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Authentication & Session Requirements

- [ ] CHK011 Are session lifetime, expiry and sign-out behavior specified at requirement level? [Gap, Contract `/session`]
- [ ] CHK012 Are CSRF and cookie-attribute requirements stated in the spec or only in the plan? [Traceability, Plan §Identity Boundary, Constitution VII]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the boundary between "dev identity allowed" and "production" defined by a testable condition (configuration values, startup behavior)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the production OIDC requirements (claims to validate, role mapping source) listed as requirements or explicit deferrals with an owner? [Completeness, Plan D-01..D-03]
- [ ] CHK015 Is it specified whether the dev identity picker may exist at all in any deployed environment other than a developer's machine? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-032]

## Input Validation & Error Handling Requirements

- [ ] CHK016 Are title and description limits stated in the spec, or only in the plan and contract (120/4000)? [Traceability, Spec §FR-003, Contract `NewRequest`]
- [ ] CHK017 Are rules for unknown fields, empty or whitespace-only text, and unsupported characters defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK018 Is a single error response shape (code, message, request ID) required in the spec for all failures? [Completeness, Contract `Error`] Observation: defined in the contract only.
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements stated that error messages must not leak internals or other users' data? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the treatment of invalid or non-UUID identifiers in paths specified? [Gap, Contract `/requests/{id}`]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the interim `LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH` priority set clearly marked as non-approved wherever it appears? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Contract `Priority`]
- [ ] CHK022 Are abuse-limiting requirements (rate limits, repeated submissions) addressed or explicitly excluded? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Category & Policy Consistency

- [ ] CHK023 Is it defined whether an administrator-created category requires approval, given only `ACCESS` does by decision? [Gap, Spec §FR-018, FR-021] Observation: FR-021 allows creating categories but DR-02 lists a fixed set and says nothing about approval for new ones.
- [ ] CHK024 Is it defined what happens to in-flight requests when their category is deactivated or its approval setting changes? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK025 Do FR-016 ("a state in which approval is required") and FR-018 (only ACCESS) agree on where the approval rule lives? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, FR-018]

## Auditability Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 Is the audited event list identical across spec (FR-024), plan (§Audit Events) and the decision record (DR-09)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-024, Plan §Audit Events] Observation: the plan lists events (for example `AUTH_DENIED`) that the spec does not require.
- [ ] CHK027 Is it specified whether denied or refused actions are audited, and with what data? [Gap, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the required behavior defined when the audit write fails (the action fails or proceeds)? [Gap, Plan §Audit Events]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the difference between the employee-visible status timeline and the restricted audit trail stated in requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, FR-025]
- [ ] CHK030 Who may read audit data is undecided (OQ-11); is the interim "admin only" recorded as a requirement-level assumption? [Dependency, Spec §FR-025, Plan D-06]
- [ ] CHK031 Are content restrictions for audit records (no secrets, minimal personal data) required in the spec? [Gap, Spec §FR-024, Constitution IV, VIII]
- [ ] CHK032 Is "protected from modification by ordinary users" precise about privileged operators (database owner, migrations)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK033 Are audit retention and deletion requirements marked as an open decision wherever audit data is described? [Completeness, Spec OQ-10, Plan D-07]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the non-tamper-proof limitation stated in a place a stakeholder would read (spec, not only constitution)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026]

## Negative Paths & Edge Cases

- [ ] CHK035 Is every protected resource (requests, history, categories, users, audit, assignment, transitions) paired with at least one specified negative scenario? [Coverage, Constitution VI, Spec §User Stories]
- [ ] CHK036 Are concurrency requirements defined (two approvals, approve while reassigning, double close)? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK037 Are the outcomes of repeated or replayed actions (second approval of an approved request) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the required result of a transition attempted on a terminal request (`CLOSED`, `REJECTED`) stated? [Coverage, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK039 Are partial-failure and recovery requirements for multi-step writes (status change plus history plus audit) specified or excluded? [Gap, Plan §Audit Events]
- [ ] CHK040 Are the cross-user, self-approval, invalid-transition and malformed-input cases from the constitution each traceable to a spec scenario? [Traceability, Constitution VI, Spec §US2, US3, US4]

## Testability & Measurability

- [ ] CHK041 Can SC-001 ("in a single sitting, without help from IT") be judged objectively? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK042 Is "usable on both desktop and mobile" defined with viewport sizes or criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028, SC-007]
- [ ] CHK043 Is the "100%" in SC-003 tied to a defined set of access-attempt types so completeness can be judged? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK044 Do all functional requirements carry at least one acceptance scenario, and is the mapping documented? [Traceability, Spec §Requirements, §User Scenarios] Observation: for example FR-033 and FR-026 have no scenario.
- [ ] CHK045 Is the contract's coverage of every spec-required error case (400, 401, 403, 404, 409) complete for each operation? [Completeness, Contract §paths]
- [ ] CHK046 Are the documented quickstart scenarios sufficient to demonstrate each constitution gate item without claiming verification? [Coverage, Plan §Quickstart, Constitution Quality Gates]
- [ ] CHK047 Is it stated that generated documents and checklists do not constitute proof of compliance or hardening? [Completeness, Constitution VIII, Gate F]

## Dependencies, Assumptions & Open Decisions

- [ ] CHK048 Does every interim technical choice (D-04..D-08) name the open question it depends on and the trigger to revisit? [Traceability, Plan §Unresolved Technical Decisions]
- [ ] CHK049 Are the open questions that block task generation (OQ-03, OQ-05, OQ-06, OQ-11) separated from those that do not? [Clarity, Spec §Open Questions]
- [ ] CHK050 Is the assumption of one role per user validated against the manager-requesting-access scenario? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §US4]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
